title: Set up approvals
old: 1. Open a task and select **Request approval**.
2. Choose one person as the approver.
3. The approver gets an email and can approve or reject.
Note: each approval step has exactly one approver.

lines.text: 1. Open a task and select **Request approval**.
2. Choose a person or a group as the approver.
3. The approver gets an email and can approve or reject. If you chose a group, any one member can approve.
Note: each approval step has one approver, which can be a person or a group.

why: Every changed line traces to R2, the steps stay in order, and nothing new is claimed. Approve it.

title: Projects 101, Lesson 3: Build your first timeline
old: Objective: Learners will build a project timeline with dependencies for a 4-week launch plan.
Practice: open the sample project, select the **Timeline** tab, and set dates for the 6 launch tasks.
Knowledge check: Where do you find the Timeline? (a) Reports (b) the Timeline tab (c) Settings

lines.text: Objective: Learners will build a project roadmap with dependencies for a 4-week launch plan.
Practice: open the sample project, select the **Plan** tab, then **Roadmap**, and set dates for the 6 launch tasks.
Knowledge check: Where do you find the Roadmap? (a) Reports (b) the Plan tab (c) Settings
